title: Learning to Quantize for Training Vector-Quantized Networks
summary: With unchanged nearest-code assignments, literal unrolled stop-gradient differentiation gives0.4 while Eq16 gives0.576 for all sufficiently small finite-difference steps. Finite-update task feedback can remain useful; no benchmark refutation.
limitations: No author-code, Torch or Betty execution; installed selected Python lacks Torch, and unversioned Betty dependency source is not staged.
No benchmark, data/weight downloads, historical run reproduction or exact inner convergence test.
Current release has SGD codebook optimizer and absolute-error reconstruction routine; historical VQVAE configuration remains unbound.
No full corrected objective, higher-order estimator or convergence theorem certified.
No separate supplement supplied; OpenReview403 makes separate supplement presence undetermined.
References pp10-13 not exhaustively checked; no comprehensive later-version or erratum search.
Visible model-selector observation and conversation URL remain controller-owned and unavailable; no Space reference supplied.

problems.source_claim: Equations12-16 compute/approximate the gradient of the one-step unrolled objective using mixed derivatives and finite differences; Sec4.3 interprets them as best-response gradient paths.
assumptions: Point input/target0; scalar F_phi=phi and G_theta(z)=theta*z.
Affine hyper-net generates codes(psi,psi+10); one parameter component examined with others fixed.
phi=theta=psi=1, alpha=beta=1, xi=.1; all allowed by local derivation.
First code strictly nearest before and after inner step and for all tested perturbations; no boundary/tie.
Squared task/commitment/codebook losses and exactly stated stop-gradient/STE; optional gamma0.
problems.check: Inner gradients2,2 yield phi'=theta'=.8. Literal mixed AD derivatives wrtpsi are0. Outer direct gradient.4 and full unrolled AD.4. v_phi=.88,v_theta1.6. Eq16 FDphi=-1.76,FDtheta0,sohypergradient.576 for eps.01,.0001,.000001. Exact symbolic result constant as eps->0.
problems.result: FD is not a consistent approximation to the stated graph derivative; recomputed fields also have nonsymmetric cross derivatives (0,4) versus(-2,0). Ordinary numerical unrolled scalar derivative1.44 also differs.
problems.counterevidence: FD update contains task information through v_phi and may be empirically useful; standard formula valid for a suitable C2 objective; one-step approximation itself explicitly acknowledged. A new higher-order estimator would require definition and proof.
problems.core_dependency: Central bilevel optimizer construction and best-response/task-gradient interpretation; indirect-gradient ablation interpretation depends on equivalence.
problems.impact: Major invalid core derivation; no empirical score or whole-framework refutation.

correction.statement: Specify differentiated object and derive a consistent surrogate/estimator.
correction.limits: No new training algorithm or complete objective certified; counterexample does not negate usefulness of finite-perturbation heuristic.

clarifications.result: Acknowledged by paper; not itself graded as defect.
Present through outer v_phi even though claimed derivative identity fails.
Current optimizer is codebook SGD; shared reconstruction loss uses absolute error. Release mainly supplies FFHQ MQGAN. Does not establish historical VQVAE configuration or benchmark invalidity.
